description: TU Delft provides MATLAB research material for car-following heterogeneity and its effects on traffic safety and sustainability. The bundle separates parameter calibration, behavioural classification and traffic-flow simulation. A semi-supervised driving-style classification method is coupled with microsimulation across sixty-six fine-grained traffic scenarios. The native description identifies two real-world source datasets and spreadsheet, CSV, MATLAB and document components. Coverage: the metadata does not state a complete observation period or geographic evaluation extent. Access: public native metadata identifies the research release. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Cost and current file access remain unknown. Caveats: The individual-agent classification follows the source-defined car-following microsimulation purpose. Detailed model equations, agent rules and dataset names are unstated. Related driving-heterogeneity bundles have different native identities. Safety and sustainability findings were not independently reproduced.
